pos.personaBrief: No verified tactical evidence (pos is a gap); from general knowledge, Pedro Emanuel is a pragmatic coach whose cup wins at Académica, Apollon and Al Taawoun came mostly as an underdog, built on defensive organisation and counter-attacks rather than possession.

pro.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge his teams progress fairly directly, looking for forwards early and avoiding risk near their own box, which fits an underdog cup-winning record.

est.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge, as a former Porto centre-back trained in the Portuguese school, he favours clear, rehearsed positions and an organised shape over free relational play.

lar.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge his counter-oriented sides use the flanks and crosses as a main attacking route rather than packing the middle.

blo.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge he sets compact mid-to-low blocks, as in the Académica 2011-12 cup run, with forwards still helping the first line but no all-out high press.

mar.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge he follows Portuguese zonal defending, with defenders protecting space rather than following individual opponents.

pla.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge he is an adaptive coach who has worked in Portugal, Cyprus, Spain, the Gulf and Brazil, shaping plans around his squad and the opponent, especially as an underdog in cup finals.

res.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge his profile is result-first: his counted spells are defined by cup trophies (Taça de Portugal 2011-12, Cypriot Cup 2015-16, King's Cup 2019) won through pragmatism rather than spectacle.

sis.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge, coaching mostly modest squads, he relies on collective organisation and tactical duties for everyone rather than on stars' freedom.

jog.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge, as a former combative centre-back, he values physical intensity, duels and aerial strength, especially in defensive midfielders.

bas.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge his short spells at many clubs, often in the Gulf, rely on experienced players and signings rather than academy development.

lid.personaBrief: Gap axis; from general knowledge, a former Porto captain, he leads with clear authority and equal rules, while valuing group unity and listening to dressing-room leaders.
